## About Me
I'm an undergrad at [Duke University](https://www.duke.edu) studying Physics and Mathematics, with a minor in Statistical Science. 
I’m broadly interested in scientific machine learning theory/methods. Specifics include:

  + Learning dynamical systems
  + Theory of generative modeling
  + Physics-informed methods
  + Geometric and dynamics perspectives

I care about applications in microbiology, materials, and quantum systems. I'm also curious about graph methods and representation learning in general. 
I was born in Beijing, China and live in Cary, NC. My given name is Xiran; I go by Derek. 

I've put some hand-written lecture notes and notes on select topics [here](notes.html). 


## Experience
As part of the [Lingchong You Lab](https://www.youlab.bio/), I work with VAE models for time-series parameter estimation on bacterial growth curves,
specifically targeting chaotic ODE-driven systems. 

As part of the [Liberata](https://liberata.info/) Algorithms Team, I'm developing graph- and embedding-based algorithms
for a new academic publishing system based on continuous authorship shares.

In Summer 2026, I will be an undergrad research intern at [Oak Ridge National Lab](https://www.ornl.gov/). 

In Summer 2025, I was an AI R&D intern at [Lenovo](https://www.lenovo.com/us/en/) with the 
[Cloud Service Providers](https://www.lenovo.com/us/en/servers-storage/solutions/cloud-service-provider/), where I assembled
an AI cluster testbed and looked at network optimization schemes.

## Involvements

I lead the Research Committee for the Statistical Science Majors Union (SSMU), where I organize a 
seminar series and reading group on theory/methods in modern statistics. More [here](ssmu.html).

I am also a part of the Math Community Team in the Duke Math Department, where I help run undergrad activities, including a mini-colloquium series. 
I made some custom math board/party games [here](math-games.html). I also serve as an Event Coordinator for the Society of Physics Students.

I'm a graphic designer of 8+ years, primarily via Photoshop and (more recently) Figma. 
I served as a co-director of [HackDuke](https://hackduke.org/) in 2025-2026, where I led the Design Team. 
I also design for the Duke Math Union, in particular the annual [Duke Math Meet](https://dukemathmeet.org/). See some past works [here](design.html).

I'm also a recreational photographer. I've done sports photography in the past; now I do mostly events and nature. See some photos [here](photos.html).
